reflectionReceiptCommand:
python3 .chaos-engine/hooks/reflection.py receipt \
  --session-id SESSION_ID \
  --session-token SESSION_TOKEN \
  --json '{"schemaVersion":1,"taskId":"issue-123","trigger":"repeated-fingerprint","failureFingerprints":["COPY_HASH_FROM_CHECKPOINT"],"failedAssumption":"The unchanged retry would add evidence.","approachesCompared":["Inspect the bounded state","Change one diagnostic input"],"chosenExperiment":"Run the changed diagnostic check.","changedApproach":"Stopped the unchanged retry.","proofCommandOrCheck":"focused check","proofOutcome":"The focused check passed.","durableDisposition":"nothing-durable"}'

chaosEngineOperatorCommands.windows:
py -3 .chaos-engine/install.py status --project . --json
py -3 .chaos-engine/install.py explain SessionStart --project . --host codex --json
py -3 .chaos-engine/install.py rollback --project .
chaosEngineOperatorCommands.posix:
python3 .chaos-engine/install.py status --project . --json
python3 .chaos-engine/install.py explain SessionStart --project . --host codex --json
python3 .chaos-engine/install.py rollback --project .

allureReportPath: allure-results and the generated Allure report under the project target output
lighthouseSetupCommands:
shaft-cli setup status --profile LIGHTHOUSE
shaft-cli setup plan \
  --profile LIGHTHOUSE \
  --mode MANAGED \
  --output /absolute/path/lighthouse-plan.json
shaft-cli setup install \
  --plan /absolute/path/lighthouse-plan.json \
  --approve sha256:<reviewed-digest>
shaft-cli setup verify --profile LIGHTHOUSE
androidSetupCommands:
shaft-cli setup status --profile MOBILE_ANDROID --mode MANAGED
shaft-cli setup plan \
  --profile MOBILE_ANDROID \
  --mode MANAGED \
  --output /absolute/path/android-plan.json
shaft-cli setup install \
  --plan /absolute/path/android-plan.json \
  --approve sha256:<reviewed-digest> \
  --accept-license android-sdk-license
shaft-cli setup verify --profile MOBILE_ANDROID --mode MANAGED
shaft-cli setup start \
  --plan /absolute/path/android-plan.json \
  --approve sha256:<reviewed-digest> \
  --accept-license android-sdk-license
shaft-cli setup logs --profile MOBILE_ANDROID
shaft-cli setup stop --profile MOBILE_ANDROID
playwrightSetupCommands:
shaft-cli setup status --profile PLAYWRIGHT --mode MANAGED
shaft-cli setup plan \
  --profile PLAYWRIGHT \
  --mode MANAGED \
  --output /absolute/path/playwright-plan.json
shaft-cli setup install \
  --plan /absolute/path/playwright-plan.json \
  --approve sha256:<reviewed-digest>
shaft-cli setup verify --profile PLAYWRIGHT --mode MANAGED
managedLocalAiSetupCommands:
shaft-cli setup status --profile LOCAL_AI --mode MANAGED
shaft-cli setup plan \
  --profile LOCAL_AI \
  --mode MANAGED \
  --operation INSTALL \
  --output /absolute/path/local-ai-plan.json
shaft-cli setup install \
  --plan /absolute/path/local-ai-plan.json \
  --approve sha256:<reviewed-digest> \
  --accept-license MIT \
  --accept-license Apache-2.0
shaft-cli setup verify --profile LOCAL_AI --mode MANAGED
shaft-cli doctor local-ai-status
